name: rhorent-car-rental-rhodes
description: Official RhoRent Rhodes car rental availability, prices, locations, rental policies, and booking links.

interface.longDescription: Find RhoRent car rental options in Rhodes, Greece. Check live vehicle availability and total rental prices for your requested dates, driver age group, and pickup and return locations; browse the fleet; and receive official booking links. Ask about verified RhoRent policies, fuel rules, airport collection, child-seat options, payment terms, and other rental questions. Fleet listings alone are not live availability. Prices and availability come from the RhoRent rental system and may change before booking. Reservations, payments and changes to existing bookings are completed outside ChatGPT through RhoRent’s official website or reservations team. Do not share payment card details in chat.
defaultPrompt: What is the RhoRent fuel policy?
Do you have a car rental desk at Rhodes Airport?
What automatic cars are available in Rhodes for my travel dates?

positive.expected_behavior: Explain Same-to-Same fuel: the car must be returned with the same fuel level it had at pickup. Do not claim every vehicle must be returned full.

positive.description: Live small automatic availability, total pricing and booking links
positive.prompt: I need a small automatic car at Rhodes Airport from May 20, 2027 at 10:00 to May 27, 2027 at 10:00. I am 35. What is available, what are the total prices, and where can I book?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify Rhodes Airport pickup and return using official location IDs, query the live rental API with driver age group age2, and show only available automatic vehicles and API-provided total prices. Provide official RhoRent booking links. If the API returns none, report that accurately. Never imply the booking was completed.

positive.description: Rhodes Airport counter and collection information
positive.prompt: Does RhoRent have its own desk inside Rhodes Airport? Where do I collect my car?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the verified airport desk inside the Arrivals Terminal and the verified collection arrangements. Do not invent shuttle pickup or alternative desk locations.

positive.prompt: Can I take my RhoRent rental car on a ferry to Symi for two days and bring it back to Rhodes?
positive.expected_behavior: State clearly that RhoRent does not permit transporting rental cars by ferry or sea, including Symi, even for a round trip. Offer the safe alternative of travelling as a foot passenger while leaving the car legally parked on Rhodes.

positive.description: Infant-seat selection, price and safe installation guidance
positive.prompt: I am renting at Rhodes Airport with my 8-month-old baby. Can I request an infant seat? Is it guaranteed, what does it cost, and can your staff install it?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain IFS infant seat for ages 0–12 months, selection through the booking flow subject to availability, and that the current extra price is shown after vehicle selection. Do not guarantee supply or invent prices. The parent/guardian installs the seat; staff can provide fitting guidance.

negative.description: Out-of-scope car rental on Crete, not Rhodes
negative.prompt: I need a rental car at Heraklion Airport in Crete for July 12 to 19. Can you find vehicles and prices?

negative.description: Hotel reservations in Rhodes are outside RhoRent car rental
negative.prompt: Can you find and reserve a hotel room in Rhodes Old Town for two guests next weekend?

negative.description: Airline flight booking is outside RhoRent car rental
negative.prompt: Please compare flight prices and book two airline tickets from Athens to Rhodes next Friday.

review.commerce_description: This plugin supplies live rental quotes and external booking links. It does not sell rentals, create reservations, or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial INTERNETi-published RhoRent MCP integration: verified policy search, official location and fleet lookup, live rental availability and pricing, and external booking links. Six read-only tools; no in-chat booking or payment. v1.0.2 adds the reviewer demonstration video URL.
